title: Set up beads and crew seats for the kit's own development
description: The user, 2026-09-29, while building the kit: 'there definitely needs to be a Bead: <id> in the commit IDs ... any further enhancements will be done in the crewkit repo, which will have its own beads setup as any other project does.' Then: 'set up and add it as a second commit'. So this repo adopts its own kit: beads (prefix ck), crew/ for seats, CLAUDE.md with the beads rules and this repo's own rules, landed as the commit after 1.1.0.
design: Followed the /crew:adopt steps. Undid the commit bd init makes on its own so the setup lands as one commit with a Bead trailer. No crew/prefix: the folder name crewkit is already short. No TODO.md or AGENTS.md to convert. The quality gate in CLAUDE.md is plugin validation plus a shell syntax check, since the kit has no test suite.
close_reason: This repo now runs on its own kit: beads (prefix ck, export.auto on), crew/ (pointer README, empty roster, Stargate canon), CLAUDE.md with this repo's rules (public: no other project's names or ids, no emails, no Claude-Session links; Bead trailers; releases per README; quality gate) and the beads section. bd init's own commit was undone so the setup lands as the second commit, after 1.1.0. Verified: the installed kit's SessionStart hook in this folder prints the beads workflow and '## No seat' and copied PRIME.md into .beads/; the quality gate passes (strict plugin validation, sh -n on all three scripts); a grep of the new files finds no other project's names, emails or session links. Not done: the first seat (the user runs crew-wake new here). No plugin release: nothing the plugin ships changed.
